newsitem.title: USA: Travelers unit files for $400 mln offer.
newsitem.headline: Travelers unit files for $400 mln offer.

text.p: Commercial Credit Co., a unit of Travelers Group Inc, on Wednesday filed with the Securities and Echange Commission for up to $400 million in trust preferred securities.

The securities represent undivided interests in the assets of CCC Capital I, a business trust formed solely to issue preferred and common securities and investing proceeds in the junior subordinated debt securities of Commercial Credit.
Commercial Credit will use the proceeds for general purposes. It plans to apply to list the preferred securities on tne New York Stock Exchange, according to the filing.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc.
